evals.prompt: /sharpen-saw audit my last five sessions for general friction.
expected_chat_output: Runs scripts/sharpen_saw.py audit --last 5 once instead of reading raw .jsonl transcripts into context.
Prioritizes error clusters that recur across two or more sessions and contrasts each failed command with its succeeding sibling.
Classifies each finding by root cause and proposes fixes by tier (global rule, hook or shim, skill, project docs) using affirmative wording.
Asks for the user's go-ahead before changing any rule, hook, script or skill.
expected_repo_state: A tool_optimization_report.md is written to a scratch location.
No rules, settings, skills or scripts are modified before the user approves.

evals.prompt: Using the sharpen-saw skill, how do I look at what happened around bookmark L-a1b2c3d4-3 and then close it once the fix has landed?
expected_chat_output: Recommends scripts/sharpen_saw.py view L-a1b2c3d4-3 (optionally with --window) to see the steps around the bookmark.
Recommends scripts/sharpen_saw.py resolve L-a1b2c3d4-3 to close it.
